parameters.description: Filter properties applicable to a specific entity type

403.description: Team membership required for team scope

get.summary: Get all options for a property (for dropdowns)

post.summary: Add a new option to a property dropdown

patch.summary: Update a property option in place (rename / recolor / reorder).
patch.description: The option id is preserved, so the change is reflected on every entity that references it.

Only returns properties for entities the user has view permission for.

403.description: Forbidden - User does not have permission

get.summary: Get all properties for an entity

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Entity type (user, document, channel, project, thread)

parameters.name: include_metadata
parameters.description: Whether to include property metadata (default: false)

403.description: Forbidden - User does not have permission to view this entity

put.summary: Set or update a property value for an entity, or attach a property without a value

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Entity type (user, document, channel, project, thread)

204.description: Entity property set successfully (with or without value)

post.summary: Add a single option to an entity's multi-select property value.
post.description:
Atomic delta: the option is appended to the current stored value (deduped,
attaching the property if needed), so concurrent edits to the same value
merge rather than overwrite each other. Prefer this over the full-value PUT
when adding one option.

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Entity type (user, document, channel, project, thread)

400.description: Invalid request, property is not multi-select, or option does not belong to the property

403.description: No edit access to the entity

delete.summary: Remove a single option from an entity's multi-select property value.
delete.description:
Atomic delta: the option is stripped from the current stored value (a no-op
if absent), so concurrent edits to the same value merge rather than overwrite
each other.

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: Entity type (user, document, channel, project, thread)

403.description: No edit access to the entity

delete.summary: Remove a specific entity property by its ID

403.description: Property is required and cannot be removed

get.summary:
List the caller's tag sets: their personal set, plus their team's set when on a team.
Pure read - a scope with no provisioned definition yet returns an empty set.

post.summary:
Provision (get-or-create) the caller's tag set for a scope and return it. Called when
the caller creates their first label for that scope, so the read path stays side-effect free.

403.description: Team membership required for team scope

AddNumberOptionRequest.description: Type-safe request to add a number option to a SelectNumber property.

oneOf.description: Add a string option to a SelectString property
Add a number option to a SelectNumber property

AddPropertyOptionRequest.description: Enum for type-safe property option addition requests.

AddStringOptionRequest.description: Type-safe request to add a string option to a SelectString property.

BulkEntityPropertiesRequest.description: Request for getting properties for multiple entities in bulk

entities.description: Array of entity references (entity_id and entity_type pairs)

property_ids.description: Optional: only return properties with these definition IDs. If empty, returns all.

CreatePropertyDefinitionRequest.description: Request to create a new property definition.

CreatePropertyScope.description:
Ownership scope a client may request when creating a property definition.
The owning user or team is derived server-side from the authenticated caller -
clients never supply owner ids. System properties are not creatable via the API.

DataType.description: Data type for property values, determining storage and validation.

EnsureTagSetRequest.description: Request to provision (get-or-create) the caller's tag set for a scope.

EntityProperty.description: Assignment of a property definition to a specific entity (service representation).

EntityPropertyWithDefinition.description: Entity property with its definition, value, and options (service representation).

EntityPropertyWithDefinitionResponse.description: Entity property with definition response (API representation).

EntityQueryParams.description: Query parameters for entity properties endpoint.

include_metadata.description: Whether to include system metadata properties (default: false)

EntityReference.description: Entity reference for entity-type property values.

specific_message_id.description:
For CHANNEL, CHAT, THREAD entity types - optional specific message ID.
This allows referencing a specific message within a thread/channel/chat.

EntityType.description: Type of entity that can be referenced by entity properties.

oneOf.description:
Filter properties applicable to a specific entity type.
When provided, excludes properties that cannot be attached to this entity type
(e.g., Parent Task and Subtasks are excluded for non-task entities).

include_options.description: Whether to include property options in the response

PropertyDataType.description: Data type with embedded options for requests - provides compile-time validation.

is_metadata.description:
Flag to indicate if this is a system-generated metadata property.
Not stored in database - computed at service layer.

is_system.description: Flag to indicate if this is a system property (stored in DB).

isMetadata.description: Flag to indicate if this is a system-generated metadata property

isSystem.description: Flag to indicate if this is a system property (managed by the system)

PropertyDefinitionResponse.description: Response for property definition with optional property options

PropertyDefinitionWithOptions.description: Property definition with its associated options (service representation).

PropertyOption.description: A selectable option for select-type properties (service representation).

PropertyOptionValue.description: The value of a property option - either a string or a number.

oneOf.description: System-owned property (no user or team owner).

PropertyOwner.description: Defines who owns a property - user-scoped, team-scoped, or system.

oneOf.description:
Select option(s) - always an array (check is_multi_select to determine if single or multi)
Single-select: {"type": "SelectOption", "value": ["uuid"]} (length 0 or 1)
Multi-select: {"type": "SelectOption", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2", ...]} (length 0+)

value.description:
Select option(s) - always an array (check is_multi_select to determine if single or multi)
Single-select: {"type": "SelectOption", "value": ["uuid"]} (length 0 or 1)
Multi-select: {"type": "SelectOption", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2", ...]} (length 0+)

oneOf.description:
Entity reference(s) - always an array (check is_multi_select to determine if single or multi)
Single-select: {"type": "EntityReference", "value": [{...}]} (length 0 or 1)
Multi-select: {"type": "EntityReference", "value": [{...}, {...}, ...]} (length 0+)

value.description:
Entity reference(s) - always an array (check is_multi_select to determine if single or multi)
Single-select: {"type": "EntityReference", "value": [{...}]} (length 0 or 1)
Multi-select: {"type": "EntityReference", "value": [{...}, {...}, ...]} (length 0+)

oneOf.description:
Link value(s) - always an array (check is_multi_select to determine if single or multi)
Single-select: {"type": "Link", "value": ["https://example.com"]} (length 0 or 1)
Multi-select: {"type": "Link", "value": ["https://example.com", "https://other.com"]} (length 0+)

value.description:
Link value(s) - always an array (check is_multi_select to determine if single or multi)
Single-select: {"type": "Link", "value": ["https://example.com"]} (length 0 or 1)
Multi-select: {"type": "Link", "value": ["https://example.com", "https://other.com"]} (length 0+)

PropertyValue.description:
Property value (service representation).

Represents the actual value stored for an entity property.
This is serialized to/from JSONB in the database.

SelectNumberOption.description: Option for select number properties in requests.

SelectStringOption.description: Option for select-type properties in requests.

SetEntityPropertyRequest.description: Type-safe request for setting entity property values.

oneOf.description: The value to set for the property. If None, the property is attached to the entity without a value.
Select option by ID (for select-type properties)
Multiple select options by ID (for multi-select properties)
Multiple entity references (for multi-select entity properties)
Multiple link values (for multi-select link properties)

SetPropertyValue.description: Type-safe enum for setting entity property values - provides compile-time validation.

TagScope.description: Which owner a tag set belongs to.

TagSetResponse.description:
A tag set the caller can use. `definition` is absent until the set is provisioned
(on first label create), in which case `options` is empty.

UpdatePropertyOptionRequest.description:
Request to update a property option in place. Omitted fields keep their current value.
The option id is preserved, so the change propagates to every entity referencing it.

color.description: New color as a hex string like `#RRGGBB`.

value.description: New string value (label text). Only valid for SelectString and Tag properties.
